title: Peripheral inflammation and executive function among community samples across the lifespan: A systematic review and meta-analysis
title_zh: 周边炎症与社区样本中执行功能的关系：跨生命周期的系统综述与荟萃分析
abstract: Higher levels of peripheral inflammatory markers are proposed to disrupt cognitive processes; however, the extent to which this relationship applies to executive functions, specifically, has yet to be systematically evaluated. The current meta-analysis synthesizes all available literature measuring the association between peripheral inflammation and executive functions among community individuals across the lifespan. This systematic review searched Web of Science, PubMed, and PsycINFO for published and unpublished studies, in the English language, that assessed the association between markers of peripheral inflammation and self-report and behavioral measures of executive function. In addition to methodological and demographic information, correlation/beta coefficients were extracted from included studies to quantify the association between inflammation and executive functions. This review included 58 studies, 41 of which were included in the random-effects meta-analysis (N = 255,539). Among community individuals, higher levels of CRP and IL-6 were associated with poorer executive functioning. These results did not differ when models accounted for potential confounding variables. Meta-regressions revealed that the relationship between inflammatory biomarkers and executive function did not differ as a function of age, adiposity, or percentage of the sample who identified as female. Results of the present review indicate that higher levels of specific inflammatory markers are associated with lower performance on executive function measures; however, we observed significant heterogeneity in the study design and measurement of both inflammation and executive functioning, suggesting important considerations for future research.
abstract_zh: 本荟萃分析综合了所有可获得的文献，探讨了周边炎症与社区个体执行功能之间的关联。系统综述检索了Web of Science、PubMed和PsycINFO，纳入了已发表和未发表的英文研究，这些研究评估了周边炎症标志物与自我报告及行为测量的执行功能之间的关系。除方法学和人口统计信息外，还提取了相关系数/β系数，以量化炎症与执行功能之间的关联。本综述共纳入58项研究，其中41项被纳入随机效应荟萃分析（N = 255,539）。在社区个体中，CRP和IL-6水平升高与执行功能下降相关。这些结果在考虑潜在混杂变量后仍保持不变。元回归显示，炎症生物标志物与执行功能之间的关系在年龄、肥胖程度或样本中女性比例方面无显著差异。本综述结果表明，特定炎症标志物水平升高与执行功能测量表现下降相关；然而，我们观察到研究设计和炎症及执行功能测量方法的显著异质性，提示未来研究需考虑重要因素。
